_comment: Append one record here for every factual correction made after the initial seed. Fields: date, entityId, field, oldValue, newValue, reason, source.

entries.entityId: place-ovacik, place-faralya, place-kabak, place-alinca, place-yediburunlar, place-bel, place-patara
entries.oldValue: rough town-center estimates, confidence: medium/low, coordType: town_center_estimate
entries.newValue: OSM place-node coordinates, confidence: high, coordType: surveyed
entries.reason: Fetched real place nodes from OpenStreetMap via Overpass API instead of relying on general geographic estimates.

entries.newValue: real trail-following geometry reconstructed from OSM relation 51855 (Likya Yolu), plus a new OSM-sourced distance metric alongside the original AllTrails-derived one. route-yediburunlar-bel-patara only got a partial update (Yediburunlar→Bel) — the Bel→Patara continuation could not be reliably reconstructed (shortest network path found was ~59.5 km, judged to be a data artifact, not real geography) and is flagged, not resolved.
entries.reason: Per spec, OSM is the maintained route reference for the Lycian Way (not AllTrails). Distances for 4 of 5 reconstructed legs matched the original AllTrails-derived figures within a few percent, which is a good consistency check.
